description: Land Acquisition - Kevitiyagala, Agalawatta D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land lots, their names, types (garden, road, paddy field, etc.), claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
